    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    int n = s.length();

    if (n == 1) {
        char c = s[0];
        if (c == '0' || c == '_' || c == 'X')
            cout << "1\n";
        else
            cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    if (s[0] == '0') {
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    string digits[] = {"25", "50", "75", "00"};
    string arr1[] = {"__", "_X", "X_", "XX"};
    int way[4] = {4, 4, 4, 1};

    way[1] = (s[0] == 'X') ? 2 : 4;
    way[2] = (s[0] == 'X') ? 3 : 4;
    way[0] = (n == 2) ? 3 : way[0];
    way[1] = (n == 2) ? 3 : way[1];

    int ways = 0;
    string v = s.substr(n - 2, 2);

    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (v == digits[i]) {
            ways = 1;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (v[0] == '_' || v[0] == 'X') {
        ways = 2;
        if (v[1] == '0' && s[0] == 'X')
            ways = 1;
    } else if (v[1] == '_' || v[1] == 'X') {
        ways = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (v == arr1[i]) {
            ways = way[i];
            break;
        }
    }
    if (v == "XX" && s[0] == 'X')
        ways = 0;

    if (v[0] != '2' && v[0] != '5' && v[0] != '7' && v[0] != '0' && v[0] != 'X' && v[0] != '_')
        ways = 0;
    if (v[1] != '0' && v[1] != '5' && v[1] != 'X' && v[1] != '_')
        ways = 0;

    bool ok = false;
    long long toti = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'X')
            ok = true;
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            if (i == 0)
                toti *= 9;
            else
                toti *= 10;
        }
    }
    if (v[0] != 'X' && v[1] != 'X') {
        if (ok) {
            if (s[0] == 'X')
                toti *= 9;
            else
                toti *= 10;
        }
    }

    toti *= ways;
    cout << toti << "\n";
    return 0;
}
